conventions.generator: one numpy.random.default_rng(seed) per bootstrap call; one integers(0, n, n) draw per resample, shared by every statistic of the call
conventions.pass: p <= alpha; the p form of §8.3 governs
conventions.resampling_unit: the images of the caption set of the call (gold-defined set for SE_A, analysis set at step 8), ascending id; all captions of a drawn image move together
conventions.tau: scipy.stats.kendalltau(x, y, variant="c"); tau_b: variant="b"; ties kept
conventions.undefined_replicate: ranks below every defined replicate: counted as <= SESOI and <= -NI; a bound that falls on one is null and its comparison fails
